title: Major Agreements And Concepts Under WTO
definition: The World Trade Organization (WTO) framework governing global trade in agriculture, services, intellectual property, and industrial goods, focusing heavily on domestic support, market access, and export subsidies impacting India's food security and fiscal policies.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Prelims (direct questions on Green/Amber/Blue boxes, Peace Clause, TRIPS) and Mains GS-3 (Agriculture, Food Security, Subsidies, MSP debates, and WTO negotiations affecting India's developmental interests).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Major Agreements And Concepts Under WTO.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basics of Indian Agriculture and MSP System
